title: Lab - Taints and tolerations
description: Taint a node and see which Pods may still land there.
scenario: Taint a node and see which Pods may still land there. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Taint a node
tasks.verification: kubectl describe node node01 | grep -i taint

tasks.title: Task 2 - Observe
tasks.instructions: Create a Pod mosquito with image nginx. Where does it go, and why?
tasks.solution:
kubectl run mosquito --image=nginx
kubectl get pod mosquito -o wide
tasks.verification: Pending if node01 is the only worker, else another node

tasks.title: Task 3 - Tolerate
tasks.instructions: Create Pod bee that tolerates the taint and confirm it lands on node01.
tasks.solution:
kubectl run bee --image=nginx --dry-run=client -o yaml > bee.yaml
# add tolerations: [{key: spray, operator: Equal, value: mortein, effect: NoSchedule}]
kubectl apply -f bee.yaml
